DataSource.query:
begin 
/* CM */
select 
case when (da.date >= cast((DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, getdate()), 0)) as date) and
da.date <= cast((dateadd(day, -1, getdate())) as date)) then 'CM Year N' else 'CM Year N-1' end as periode,
oc.COD_COMPANY as ORIGIN_COMPANY, 
sum(case when alo.COD_ACCOUNTING_LOG = 'ANA' and pm.cod_product_model like 'A-8%' then 0 else sl.AMT_NET_ENTRY_SOURCE_COMP_CUR end *
case when alo.cod_accounting_log = 'ANA' then case when bac.NUM_BUCHER_ACCOUNT between 300000 and 310000 then -1 else 1 end else -1 end) as montant
from accounting.FACT_SAVING_LEDGER sl
left outer join common.DIM_DAY da on sl.SEQ_ENTRY_DAY = da.SEQ_DAY 
left outer join common.dim_company oc on sl.SEQ_SOURCE_COMPANY = oc.seq_company
left outer join common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT aa on sl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT = aa.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT 
left outer join common.DIM_ALLOCATION al on sl.SEQ_ALLOCATION = al.SEQ_ALLOCATION
left outer join common.DIM_PRODUCT_MODEL pm on sl.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL = pm.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL
left outer join common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_CODE ac on sl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_CODE = ac.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_CODE
left outer join common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_LOG alo on sl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_LOG = alo.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_LOG
left outer join common.DIM_BUCHER_ACCOUNT bac on aa.SEQ_BUCHER_ACCOUNT_DEBIT = bac.SEQ_BUCHER_ACCOUNT
where 
/* année courante */
((da.date >= cast((DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, getdate()), 0)) as date) and
da.date <= cast((dateadd(day, -1, getdate())) as date))
or 
/* année N-1 */
(da.date >= cast((DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, dateadd(year, -1, getdate())), 0)) as date) and
da.date <= cast((dateadd(day, -1, dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) as date)))
and sl.AMT_NET_ENTRY_SOURCE_COMP_CUR <> 0 
and sl.BIT_UNIQUE_INVOICING = '0'
and bac.NUM_BUCHER_ACCOUNT = 300010
and al.COD_ALLOCATION between '5000' and '5999'
and sl.NUM_CUSTOMER_ORDER not between 'FS   ' and 'FS999'
group by 
case when (da.date >= cast((DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, getdate()), 0)) as date) and
da.date <= cast((dateadd(day, -1, getdate())) as date)) then 'CM Year N' else 'CM Year N-1' end,
oc.COD_COMPANY 
union all
/* YTD */
select 
case when (seq_year = year(DATEADD(year, -1, getdate())) and
date <= cast((dateadd(day, -1, dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) as date)) then 'YTD Year N-1'  else 'YTD Year N' end as periode,
oc.COD_COMPANY as ORIGIN_COMPANY, 
sum(case when alo.COD_ACCOUNTING_LOG = 'ANA' and pm.cod_product_model like 'A-8%' then 0 else sl.AMT_NET_ENTRY_SOURCE_COMP_CUR end *
case when alo.cod_accounting_log = 'ANA' then case when bac.NUM_BUCHER_ACCOUNT between 300000 and 310000 then -1 else 1 end else -1 end) as montant
from accounting.FACT_SAVING_LEDGER sl
left outer join common.DIM_DAY da on sl.SEQ_ENTRY_DAY = da.SEQ_DAY 
left outer join common.dim_company oc on sl.SEQ_SOURCE_COMPANY = oc.seq_company
left outer join common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT aa on sl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT = aa.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT 
left outer join common.DIM_ALLOCATION al on sl.SEQ_ALLOCATION = al.SEQ_ALLOCATION
left outer join common.DIM_PRODUCT_MODEL pm on sl.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL = pm.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL
left outer join common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_CODE ac on sl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_CODE = ac.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_CODE
left outer join common.DIM_ACCOUNTING_LOG alo on sl.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_LOG = alo.SEQ_ACCOUNTING_LOG
left outer join common.DIM_BUCHER_ACCOUNT bac on aa.SEQ_BUCHER_ACCOUNT_DEBIT = bac.SEQ_BUCHER_ACCOUNT
where 
/* année N-1*/
((seq_year = year(DATEADD(year, -1, getdate())) and
date <= cast((dateadd(day, -1, dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) as date))
or 
/* année courante */
(seq_year = year(getdate()) and
date <= cast((dateadd(day, -1, getdate())) as date)))
and sl.AMT_NET_ENTRY_SOURCE_COMP_CUR <> 0 
and sl.BIT_UNIQUE_INVOICING = '0'
and bac.NUM_BUCHER_ACCOUNT = 300010
and al.COD_ALLOCATION between '5000' and '5999'
and sl.NUM_CUSTOMER_ORDER not between 'FS   ' and 'FS999'
group by 
case when (seq_year = year(DATEADD(year, -1, getdate())) and
date <= cast((dateadd(day, -1, dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) as date)) then 'YTD Year N-1'  else 'YTD Year N' end,
oc.COD_COMPANY 
end
